mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID, PAY_METHOD, SUM(AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM EXPENSE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND USED_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{taxYear} || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') AND USED_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{taxYear} || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD'), 12) GROUP BY CATEGORY_ID, PAY_METHOD ORDER BY CATEGORY_ID, PAY_METHOD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PREDICTION (PREDICTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, TAX_YEAR, TAXABLE_INCOME, CALCULATED_TAX, DECIDED_TAX, EXPECTED_REFUND) VALUES (#{predictionId}, #{memberId}, #{result.taxYear}, #{result.taxableIncome}, #{result.calculatedTax}, #{result.decidedTax}, #{result.expectedRefund})

INSERT INTO PREDICTION_INPUT (PREDICTION_ID, TOTAL_SALARY, WITHHELD_TAX, NATIONAL_PENSION, DEPENDENTS, MONTHLY_RENT, HOUSING_SAVING, PENSION_SAVING, SME_REDUCTION_YN, HOMELESS_HEAD_YN, CHILDREN, HEALTH_INSURANCE, IRP_SAVING) VALUES (#{predictionId}, #{income.totalSalary}, #{income.withheldTax}, #{income.nationalPension}, #{income.dependents}, #{income.monthlyRent}, #{income.housingSaving}, #{income.pensionSaving}, #{income.smeReductionYn}, #{homelessHeadYn}, #{income.children}, #{income.healthInsurance}, #{income.irpSaving})
INSERT INTO PREDICTION_DETAIL (DETAIL_ID, PREDICTION_ID, TYPE_ID, BASE_AMOUNT, DEDUCTION_AMOUNT) VALUES (SEQ_PREDICTION_DETAIL.NEXTVAL, #{predictionId}, #{typeId}, #{baseAmount}, #{deductionAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT p.PREDICTION_ID, p.TAX_YEAR, i.TOTAL_SALARY, i.WITHHELD_TAX, p.TAXABLE_INCOME, p.CALCULATED_TAX, p.DECIDED_TAX, p.EXPECTED_REFUND FROM PREDICTION p JOIN PREDICTION_INPUT i ON i.PREDICTION_ID = p.PREDICTION_ID WHERE p.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND p.TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear} AND p.BASE_PREDICTION_ID IS NULL ORDER BY p.PREDICTED_AT DESC, p.PREDICTION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT t.TYPE_CODE, t.TYPE_NAME, t.DEDUCTION_KIND AS KIND, d.BASE_AMOUNT, d.DEDUCTION_AMOUNT, t.SOURCE_NOTE FROM PREDICTION_DETAIL d JOIN PREDICTION p ON p.PREDICTION_ID = d.PREDICTION_ID JOIN DEDUCTION_TYPE t ON t.TYPE_ID = d.TYPE_ID WHERE d.PREDICTION_ID = #{predictionId} AND p.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY d.DETAIL_ID
